newsitem.title: USA: US corporate mergers at record and rising.
newsitem.headline: US corporate mergers at record and rising.

text.p: The number of major corporate mergers in the United States is projected to reach a record 3,580 in the fiscal year that began on Oct. 1, 1996, the Federal Trade Commission said Friday.
The government requires major mergers be reported so they can be reviewed for possible violations of antitrust laws.
The number of mergers during fiscal 1996 ending last Sept. 30 was 3,087, breaking the previous record of 2,883 in fiscal 1989.
After the go-go 1980s, the number of mergers dropped off to 1,529 in fiscal 1991, but picked up in the latter part of the decade.

Merger filing rules are complex, but if one of the companies involved has sales or assets of $100 million and the other has sales or assets of $10 million, the companies may have to report the merger.
Nearly all the mergers -- roughly 98 percent -- are permitted to go through without question, the FTC says.
